channel.title: Comments for page "And Then What Happened?"
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "And Then What Happened?"

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
“Of course, of course. Most people are keeping it pretty small this time around, as far as I can tell. The age of explosions and fireworks is winding down. ‘Loud and in your face’ has been done a billion times.”

“I doubt there won’t be a billion and first.”

"What? Nobody even used ‘press buten 4 firwroks’, this is downright puritanical!"

Perfect.

Though, I might say that the Snip. Snip. Snip. at the end is a bit too heavy handed, presuming I'm guessing things correctly.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Sculptor's part comes off a bit as singing Duchamp's praises, but this has me excited for the next installment. I do also like the look at one of the embedded agents.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Not all anartists would necessarily be part of AWCY or any of its crazed predecessors. Consider SCP-841, for instance.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I feel the same way, though, points for using ones that actually -would- make sense for them to be the creations of anartists. Hanged Man's play, 173, ect. I don't -like- thinking of them as the work of AWCY or any of their predecessors or the like, but at least the logic is solid.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: While I must admit I'm slight peeved at every anomaly in this series being attributed to anartist, I'm still looking forward to the big exhibit. This tale feels like the rumblings before an earthquake.
